audit.why: Cho'Gath owning 1-5 with level 6 going even matches 60% over 20 games, and the reason is already stated correctly in the content layer: Feral Scream's silence is what makes his combo land, and Riftwalk is the answer. Chart left alone.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's spikes were generic and the ult was never treated as a spike.
audit.why: Feast is 80/70/60s and permanently grows his max health on every kill, so his power curve is a staircase tied to that cooldown, not a smooth ramp. Rupture is only 6s, so 'wait for Rupture' is almost never the plan.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, report[9].t and dosFull[2].d now carry 6s, 11s and 80s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entire full layer tracked Rupture and never once mentioned Feral Scream, even though the silence is the only thing in his kit that shuts off Riftwalk - which the content layer correctly identifies as the matchup-definer. It also never said Feast is true damage.
audit.why: Riot: 'Feral Scream ... dealing magic damage and Silencing enemies for a few seconds' and 'Feast: Devours an enemy unit, dealing a high amount of true damage'. Silence locks Riftwalk; true damage passes through both Void Stone and Null Sphere's magic shield.
audit.corrected: Rewrote report[5].t, breakdown.cooldowns, tradeBad, loading and dontsFull[2] around Feral Scream and Feast.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Commit on Rupture's cooldown' was the headline advice.
audit.why: Rupture is a 6-second ability - it is essentially always up, so it is the wrong thing to wait on. Feral Scream at 11s is the cooldown that actually opens a window.
audit.corrected: report[9].t and breakdown.cooldowns now point at Feral Scream's 11 seconds instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization ended with 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain'.
audit.why: Cho'Gath's only healing is Carnivore, which triggers on his own last hits and cannot be contested in a trade. Grievous Wounds is a wasted slot; the real itemization note is that Feast is true damage, so no amount of MR touches it.

notes: The full layer for this matchup tracked Rupture in twelve fields and never mentioned Feral Scream once, even though the silence - not the knockup - is what actually beats Kassadin, because a silenced Kassadin cannot cast Riftwalk. Rupture is also only a 6-second cooldown, so 'commit on Rupture's cooldown' was advice you can never act on; the 11-second Feral Scream is the real window. FLAG MISFIRE: chogath.json tags Rupture with 'grounding', but Riot's description says it pops units into the air and slows - no grounding. I did not write a grounding claim, which matters here because a false grounding line would tell a Kassadin his blink is dead when it is not.
